unasked.purpose: Whether the release channel names a newer release: the channel's timestamp, any newer root file, and the newest release's manifest and release-log bundle, verified as an update verifies them.
unasked.when: At a Host start when the last check is at least intervalHours old (24 by default), then every interval while the Host runs.
unasked.sends: Bare GET requests for the named files: no query, cookie, body, installation or plugin detail.

unasked.purpose: Contract C18's online check of the installed release against the public release log: the log's latest checkpoint and the tiles that prove consistency with the stored one.
hosts: the log origin the trusted root names
unasked.when: At each launcher start while the installed release is unchecked, before a home process starts a version without the launcher (an update's or a rollback's successor), and every 15 minutes in a running home until the log answers.
unasked.sends: Bare GET requests for the checkpoint and tiles: no query, cookie, body or installation detail.

switch.reason: integrity.mode, which the threat model names as the switch for the integrity checks, is not built yet

asked.purpose: Installing Delo with its launcher, and delorun update: the release channel's files, the runtime archive and the release-log check.
delorun update --check, the update check run when the person asks, whatever the switch says.

Delo's egress proxy, which forwards a sandboxed command's own request to a host on its workspace's network allowlist, after looking up only listed names and refusing private, loopback and link-local addresses. It runs only for a workspace whose network the person set to allowlist, and sends only what the command sends.

The plugin install check when the person installs, enables or restores a plugin, in the studio or with delorun plugin: npm's bulk advisory API for the new packages' names and versions, and the registry's package document of each for its publish time.
Setup's live check of a typed model key, through upstream's model-listing client, to the provider's origin only.

local.reason: Reads the handover pipe an update's predecessor passes as an inherited file descriptor.
Reads the launch pipe the CLI passes the Docker supervisor as an inherited file descriptor.
